name: Reduce test code duplication (DRY) in tests/
goal: Reduce test code duplication in tests/ using evidence .jscpd/tests/html/jscpd-report.json (273 clones, 5,629 duplicated lines). Discard duplicated boilerplate that does not belong (e.g. per-file test-runner loops), extract reusable fixtures/helpers, drive tests through the SDK, mock where needed, to lower DRY blocks. Scope: tests/ only. Deliverable: shared fixtures/helpers layer + migrated tests with materially lower jscpd duplication. src/ and scripts/ deferred to follow-up expeditions.
